app.name: AncestorsTree
app.tagline: Build your family tree together and never miss a death anniversary.
app.description: AncestorsTree — build your family tree together and never miss a death anniversary.

home.title: Your family tree, one photo at a time.
home.legend: Threads with a red pin join parents to children · stitches join spouses · red stamps are death anniversaries · yellow stickers are birthdays.

notFound.title: We could not find this page
notFound.body: The link may be outdated or mistyped.

routeError.title: Something went wrong on this page
routeError.body: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, go back to the home page.

designGallery.title: Design system
designGallery.intro: Every color, typeface and component of AncestorsTree in one place. Switch between light and dark at the top to see both.

type.body: Each person is a photo. The color of the tape shows which branch they belong to.
type.hand: Grandpa's memorial is on the full moon of the tenth month

controls.nameHint: Write it in full, with diacritics. Example: Nguyễn Văn Thịnh.
controls.dateError: The tenth lunar month of that year has only 29 days.

dialog.title: Remove Cô Hà from the tree?
dialog.body: Cô Hà will be moved to “Loose photos”. You can undo right after.

marks.note: Red stamps are death anniversaries (lunar), yellow stickers are birthdays.

threads.note: Threads with a red pin join parents to children. Stitches with a round knot join spouses.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some data is invalid. Please check it.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else just updated the family tree.
errors.RULE_VIOLATION: This change is not valid for the family tree.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You are going too fast. Please try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
